policy.notificationsHint: Members get in-app and e-mail notifications about what happens in the organization.
policy.jobsKeepHint: Exports, imports and their files are deleted this many days after they finish.
policy.brandNameHint: Shown in e-mails to your members. Leave empty to use the platform's name.
policy.brandLogoHint: An https link to an image shown at the top of e-mails. Leave empty to show the name instead.
policy.brandColorHint: Buttons and the header line of e-mails.
policy.brandFooterHint: The last line of every e-mail. Leave empty for the copyright and name.
policy.signInAlertHint: E-mail members when they sign in from somewhere they have not used in the last 90 days.
policy.requireTwoFactorHint: Members must turn on two-factor before they can use the app.
policy.deletionGraceHint: Time a member has to change their mind after asking to delete their account. 0 deletes it at the next run.
policy.systemNameHint: Shown in notifications, e-mails and the app.
policy.exportTtlHint: A person's data export can be downloaded for this long, then it is deleted.
policy.eraseDeletedHint: Deleted accounts are erased for good after this many days. 0 keeps them until someone erases them.
policy.signupOpenHint: Anyone can create an organization from the sign-up page. When off, only staff create organizations.
policy.signupPlanHint: The plan a new organization starts on.
policy.termsVersionHint: Recorded when a new owner accepts the terms. Change it when you publish new terms.
policy.paymentInstructionsHint: Shown at checkout: the bank, account name and number, and branch.
policy.orgLanguageHint: The screen language for members who haven't chosen their own, and the language of e-mails to them and to people you invite.
